All you can eat - cross-section of Vietnamese cuisine - delicious
Oct 2023 • Couples
On our trip to Indochina, our tour operator Tonkin Travel invited us to dinner here one evening.

It was a Monday evening and there was an all-you-can-eat offer. We didn't know what to order because the menu was so extensive and tempting. And the menu didn't promise too much. Everything was freshly prepared and just looking at the food was a delight. We had oysters, prawns, squid in garlic, roast duck, fried rice, seaweed, vegetables... everything looked delicious. The sauces were excellent. Our waiter Ryan was very courteous and the service was very good. The desserts were also delicious.

We can only recommend this restaurant and the menu. The variety gives a good insight and cross-section of Vietnamese cuisine.
You sit in an open back courtyard in a nice atmosphere or on the first floor in a cozy room.
